REMOTE_CHANGED.title: Changed on another device
REMOTE_CHANGED.description: This record was modified on another device after your last change.

DELETED_REMOTELY.title: Deleted on another device

WALLET_UNAVAILABLE.title: Wallet unavailable
WALLET_UNAVAILABLE.description: The wallet of this movement no longer exists or is not available to you.

INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.title: Insufficient funds
INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.description: The server rejects the movement because the wallet would end up with a negative balance.
